description.value: Hani Kebab serves authentic Persian cuisine from a counter inside Haney Place Mall in Maple Ridge, featuring halal-certified dishes crafted from generational recipes. The menu spans classic kubideh and jujeh kebabs to slow-cooked lamb shanks and traditional Persian stews. After mall hours, orders can be placed through Uber Eats or Skip The Dishes with a back-entrance pickup option.
